ratingsOriginalSchema.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but playable; 7 good with meaningful friction; 9 excellent with little observed friction; 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic assessment of observed emulated mobile play only, not an average of stats or win/loss.
ratingsOriginalSchema.overallReason: Both complete runs were understandable and rewarding in their clear objective/progress feedback. Strong atmosphere, large primary touch buttons and contextual route/recovery assistance make the mission approachable. Manual patrol touch engagement was feasible, but acquisition at the right control edge failed, distant threats were small, and close coil geometry complicated identification. Heavy assisted routing and paused observation limit confidence about sustained mobile play. Wins do not independently determine this grade.
ratingsOriginalSchema.controlsReason: MOVE plus FIRE drag, scene swipes, tap aim, DASH, map close, and START FRESH worked visibly. One right-edge target attempt failed without turn/down; continuous held rearming, unassisted precision, physical thumb comfort, ZOOM, JUMP and TOOLS remain unassessed. DASH activation observed, defensive success not established.
ratingsOriginalSchema.gameplayReason: Recoveries, coil phases, reloads and uplink provide a readable sequence with some tension from shield loss. Assisted route completion involved little navigation decision-making; two short runs do not establish sustained depth or enjoyment.
ratingsOriginalSchema.presentationReason: Cohesive rain, teal/orange lighting, industrial geometry and restrained result card support the rescue mood. Some silhouettes and foreground structures look coarse in software WebGL; performance/artifact causes cannot be assigned. Audio not assessed.
ratingsOriginalSchema.usabilityReason: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER instructions, named destinations, map route and fresh-start result button are helpful. Map overview is small and UI covers substantial scene area in landscape. No settings changed; broader settings usability unassessed.
ratingsOriginalSchema.readabilityReason: Health/ammo and objective progress are legible; explicit coil percentages/OFF and upload percentage support recovery from mistakes. Small patrols, muted contrast, tiny world labels, overlapping prompts/control areas and close coil supports complicate scene reading.
helpfulMoments: Opening instruction immediately explained tap aim, FIRE, swipe and DASH.
TARGET DOWN/SENTINEL DOWN feedback confirmed manual engagements.
Recovery checkmarks, coil OFF states and upload percentages clarified progress.
Map gave named destinations, walking route and close button without requiring mission abandonment.
Result cards exposed assist counts, so assisted runs were not mistaken for unaided skill.
frustratingMoments: Needed corrective turn to locate front-left patrol in attempt 1.
Right-side target attempt in attempt 2 failed to acquire/down; could not isolate control overlap versus other cause.
Close boss view caused mistaken coil identity and required corrective swipe.
Ammo exhaustion/reload interrupted attempted damage; individual wasted shots unresolved.

ratingsOriginalSchema.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional in the observed scope. Subjective holistic judgment of this emulated sample, not an average of victories or terminal points.

controls.reason: Large labeled MOVE/FIRE and drag/tap aiming worked in both sampled two-contact patrol engagements. Scene turning and DASH cooldown were visible. Dense lower controls, assistance, paused inputs and no continuous hold testing limit confidence.

gameplay.reason: Recover-three-signals, phased coils and exposed deck provide a coherent escalation with incoming threats. Helpful assists supported completion but dominated traversal; only two small patrol samples and coil fight assessed, limiting evidence for manual depth, balance or sustained enjoyment.

presentation.reason: Cohesive teal/amber industrial scene, rain, lighting and restrained title/result typography; satisfying clear OFF and TARGET DOWN feedback. Software-WebGL sample cannot certify performance or audio.

usability.reason: Clear changing objective, nearby HOLD APPROACH, progress checkmarks, automatic reload and visible START FRESH; planning map route and legend fit portrait. Assistance accounting on result is useful. No settings change required; menus beyond map and results unassessed.

readability.reason: Large health/ammo, progress and terminal statistics read well at390x844. Distant enemies and coil roman numerals are small; dark geometry, many labels and lower control cluster demand attention.

ratingsOriginalSchema.holistic_reason: Good, coherent mobile-oriented interface with useful navigation/combat feedback and atmosphere; noticeable small-target and interface-density friction. Wins are not the grade. No enjoyment inferred for unassessed content.
